a.lede: Record-breaking cybersecurity deal promises tighter integration, but sysadmins fear higher prices and vendor lock-in
a.title: CrowdStrike splashes $44B on Zscaler, customers brace for the bill

b.lede: The cybersecurity giant said that the deal to buy Zscaler, which provides zero-trust products to large enterprises, will better equip their customers to use AI agents.
b.title: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for $44 billion
